text:
sam: quick proposal 1 5 5 5 we should add a lightweight "migration rehearsal" and a deprecation cadence to the catalog playbook. goal: reduce surprise regressions and give customers predictable runway. thoughts?
eva: love it. what do you mean by rehearsal? a dry-run that exercises canary + rollback without touching production routing?
li: yes 4 rehearsal = staged dry-run: 1) run full preflight + canary simulation on traffic shadowing, 2) exercise rollback path end-to-end (mark reversible pin, trigger fake anomaly), 3) validate customer notification pipeline. should take ~2h.
matt: ops note: rehearsals must be safe: use traffic shadowing only (no writes), ensure KV cache is isolated, run on a cost-limited infra quota. add a rehearsal flag in catalog API: `rehearsal=true`.
anya: deprecation cadence idea: standard notice windows 90/45/21/7 days + final cutoff. include optional "expedited" path for critical security fixes (7d total). also include per-route pin expiry: if customer pins older model, pin TTL defaults to 180 days then auto-reevaluate.
sam: add blackout windows: we should never default-swap during major customer business hours for enterprise (configurable per-customer). default global blackout: Fri 12:00-18:00 PST. document exceptions.
eva: benchmarks: keep microbench (64/256/1024) and semantic sets but add a "canary-score" metric: weighted sum of quality, latency, cost, and safety signals. canary-score >= 0.85 required for default swap. show it in Console.
li: define weights: quality 0.5, latency 0.2, cost 0.15, safety 0.15. thresholds are tunable per-tier. also add a "regression-type" tag (long-context, hallucination, tokenization) so PMs know root cause quickly.
matt: routing shim: for tokenizer changes or spec drift, offer a compatibility shim that maps old tokenization to new at the routing layer for 30 days. require model owners to provide tokenizer mapping; otherwise mark as breaking change.
anya: communication templates: 1) initial heads-up (90d), 2) opt-in invite (21d), 3) final reminder (7d), 4) shutdown notice (1d). include explicit cost delta and risk blurb. enterprise contracts can override windows.
contract-bot: policy-draft created: `/policies/migration_cadence.md` (owner: anya).link: https://legal.internal/redwood/policies/migration_cadence.md
sam: rollback playbook sketch: immediate pin -> route 100% traffic to baseline variant -> create rollback incident -> run forensic diff tool to capture failing prompts -> notify customers & sales with remediation ETA. auto-rollback triggers: canary-score drop >0.2 or semantic regression >3% sustained 30m.
eva: add post-mortem checklist: collect sampled prompts, model outputs, KV cache snapshot, seed RNGs, and timeline. store artifact with migration run id.
li: infrastructure check list for rehearsals: quantized variants present, KV cache compatibility, sharded weights checksum, sequence-length smoke on 512/2048/4096. if any fail -> rehearsal fail.
matt: ops action: implement `catalog-rehearse --model new --baseline old --shadow 1h --simulate-rollback` that walks through the rehearsal steps and outputs a rehearsal-report.json. hook to deploy-bot.
contract-bot: rehearsal job queued: ID=mr-2141901234-rehearsal.ETA: 1h 20m.
anya: migration TTL + retirement policy: x versions back kept in catalog (default 3). models older than that enter "retire_notice" state and customers get 90/45/21/7 notices. add a published "retirement rationale" field for transparency.
sam: edge-case: customer-specific feature flags (e.g., route uses custom tokenizer). plan: require explicit opt-in for migration and provide per-route test harness. add a Console view: "routes at risk".
eva: monitoring: besides canary-score, wire a "customer-impact" metric that estimates percent of customer requests likely affected by behavioral changes (using diff heuristics). surface as a simple red/yellow/green badge.
li: timeline: build rehearsal CLI + canary-score calculation (2 weeks). add rehearsal run in pre-release pipeline.
matt: ops will prototype rehearsal CLI and the routing shim (2 weeks).
anya: I'll draft migration cadence + templates and the retirement rationale copy (72h).
sam: ok action items summarized: li -> rehearsal checklist + canary-score formula (48h). matt -> prototype CLI & shim (2w). anya -> templates + policy draft (72h). eva -> Console badges & "routes at risk" view (1w). sam -> assemble final playbook and one-pager after these land.
contract-bot: rehearsal job completed: status=success, report: https://ci.internal/redwood/rehearsals/mr-2141901234/report
sam: nice. schedule follow-up to run a full rehearsal against `catalog/rhea-v4` next Wed. thanks all.
